Components and links as a list

Components

  • Devices
    • HAVOC-2: flight computer in the rocket
    • RFD900 ground radio: serial
    • Weather station: LoRa receiver on serial
    • Other devices: HAVOC on USB, GPS tracker
  • COSMOS
    • Launcher: one server per device
    • cosmos-server × N: frames, parser, envelopes, rate-limited commands
    • Sim service: OpenRocket ensemble
    • React page: flight state, alarms, callouts
    • Session log: hash-chained records
    • cosmos-replay: re-serves a session
    • cosmos-verify: checks the hash chain
